## Summary

Ethyl acetate by Fischer esterification of acetic acid with ethanol.
This is sample data and is *not* experimentally verified, so treat every **quantity** here as a placeholder.

## Reagents

| Reagent | CAS | MW (g/mol) | Amount | mmol | Equiv |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Acetic acid | 64-19-7 | 60.05 | 1.20 g (1.15 mL) | 20.0 | 1.0 |
| Ethanol | 64-17-5 | 46.07 | 1.84 g (2.33 mL) | 40.0 | 2.0 |

## Procedure

1. Mix the acetic acid (1.20 g, 20.0 mmol) with the ethanol (1.84 g, 40.0 mmol).
2. Warm the mixture under reflux for one hour, then cool it and wash it with H<sub>2</sub>O.

## Workup and Purification

Separate the organic layer and dry it over a drying agent.

## Characterization

Colourless liquid with a fruity smell.

## Notes

1. Remove the water to push the equilibrium towards the ester.
2. The ester is flammable.

## Hazards and Waste Disposal

Both reagents are flammable.

## References

1. Example, A. *Fictitious Chem.* 2020, 1, 1.
